title: Chapter 357 - 357 Listen To This; Sign In Overseas!
content:
Chapter 357 - 357 Listen To This; Sign In Overseas!

Chapter 357 - 357 Listen to This; Sign In Overseas!

357 Listen to This; Sign In Overseas!

Naturally, Lin Fan and the others did not know about Li Li, Jonah, and Roger.

They looked down from the helicopter.

About ten minutes later, the helicopter slowly decelerated…

In the end, they landed on a tall helipad… This was the Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel!

“Tsk!”

When Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and Flower Stem’s employees got off the helicopter, two rows of beautiful Caucasian women with exquisite looks and graceful figures said in unison, “Welcome, Mr. Lin!”

This scene shocked Chu Yunyue and the staff of Flower Stem.

Then, everyone’s luggage was sent to the luxury suites on the top floor by the Caucasian beauties.

Lin Fan, Chu Yunyue, and the others were led to the VIP room by Chairman Jack Smith.

At this moment, the table in the VIP room was already filled with top-grade foie gras, cheese snails, top-grade steak, white truffle bagels, gold foil sundaes, caviar chocolate pudding, and many other delicacies.

When Flower Stem’s employees saw this, they could not take their eyes off.

In fact, they were not the only ones who were attracted. Even Chu Yunyue was attracted.

Lin Fan said, “Everyone has been on the plane for so long. You must be hungry and tired, right? Hurry up and eat.”

Generally speaking, one would get hungry and tired when they took a plane.

However, this time, they had taken a luxurious private plane. The plane had the best food and the best service. How could they be hungry or tired?

However, at this moment, when they saw the exquisite food, they could not help but pick up their cutlery and eat slowly.

Very soon, their stomachs became a little round, and they could not eat any more of the delicious food.

Chu Yunyue wiped her mouth with a napkin and could not help but ask, “Lin Fan, don’t tell me you’re also a major shareholder of this hotel?”

Flower Stem’s employees pricked up their ears.

Obviously, they had the same suspicion.

This was normal.

Lin Fan shook his head. “That’s not it.”

When everyone heard this, they all heaved a sigh of relief.

‘It’s alright, it’s alright… He isn’t a major shareholder of Eagle Country’s Royal Hotel.’

They had just secretly searched the internet. The Royal Hotel was a landmark building in Lun City. It was one of the most luxurious hotels in Lun City, and it cost more than billions of dollars to build!

Their little hearts would not be able to withstand the torment.

At this moment, Lin Fan continued, “I’m the owner of this hotel.”

Silence!

The entire room was silent!

The oval-faced woman, the other employees of Flower Stem, and Chu Yunyue were all stunned.

He was not the major shareholder, but the boss!

In the past, many of Flower Stem’s employees felt that Lin Fan had just provided them with some perfume recipes and beauty essence technology yet he became the biggest shareholder of Flower Pedestal. He was simply too lucky.

They guessed that Lin Fan would probably be so happy that he would not be able to sleep every day.

Now it seemed like… Lin Fan probably did not care about the shares at all.

Lin Fan did not care about the stunned crowd and asked, “Yunyue, are you full? Do you want to rest in the room?”

“I’m not that tired yet,” said Chu Yunyue. “I’ll go to the booth first.”

She was not a person who liked to relax and hated to work. In fact, she could be said to be a strong woman and a workaholic.

Otherwise, she would not have been able to establish the famous Flower Stem in Hua Nation by herself.

Lin Fan said, “Alright, I’ll go with you.”

Then, the two of them walked out side by side.

A Rolls-Royce was already waiting at the entrance. This was specially arranged by Chairman Jack Smith so that Lin Fan could travel around Eagle Country.

The driver was a Caucasian who was proficient in Hua Nation’s language and English. It was effortless for him to communicate. At the same time, he also had good driving skills.

Lin Fan was very satisfied with this.

Soon, they arrived at the International Exhibition Center.

There was a huge LED display screen in front of the door, which was playing promotional videos of different brands of perfume.

Obviously, this was the venue for the upcoming International Perfume Exhibition.

As it was not the time for the official exhibition yet, there were still some things that were not ready.

Ordinary people were not allowed to enter and exit as they pleased.

However, as one of the participating companies, Chu Yunyue, the president of Flower Stem, was naturally not an ordinary person.

When Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue walked into the exhibition center, they were greeted by a strong fragrance.

Obviously, many companies had already brought their own perfumes in.

The two of them looked into the distance and saw various booths.

After a while, they finally saw Flower Stem’s booth.

Different from the previous booth in Jiangbei City, Flower Stem’s booth this time had a younger, more energetic, and modern feel.

Two men and women in Flower Stem uniforms were adjusting and modifying some small parts of the booth. They were very serious.

As a result, they did not even see Chu Yunyue and Lin Fan’s arrival.

When a man turned around and was about to adjust the other positions of the booth, he shouted in surprise, “Chairwoman Chu, Mr. Lin!”

When the others heard this, they all stopped what they were doing. They turned around and greeted respectfully, “Chairwoman Chu, Mr. Lin.”

Chu Yunyue nodded, “You’ve worked hard. The booth is very well done!”

When the four of them heard this, their faces revealed a hint of joy.

“Thank you for your compliment, Chairwoman Chu.”

“This is what we should do.”

…

Then, Chu Yunyue gave a detailed exchange and reminder about certain places and things to pay attention to during the exhibition.

When Lin Fan and Chu Yunyue left the exhibition center, it was already two hours later.

At this moment, the sky had already darkened.

After flying for a day, they went to the exhibition center to check on the booth. All of this made Chu Yunyue very tired.

However, Chu Yunyue knew she would not be able to fall asleep anyway. As long as she was on a business trip, no matter how tired she was, she could not fall asleep.

There were some people who were instinctively wary of unfamiliar environments and would struggle to fall asleep.

However, Chu Yunyue quickly fell asleep today.

It was because she had Lin Fan by her side.

…

The next day, the sky was bright.

Lin Fan opened his eyes slowly. There was no one around him.

He habitually picked up his phone.

A text message appeared on the screen as usual.

[Notice from Merchant Bank: 7,891,030 yuan was deposited into your account.]

As he had walked more yesterday, his income was higher than usual.

Of course, Lin Fan did not care about this little bit of money.

Then, he turned his attention to the sign-in system.

He muttered in his heart, ‘This is my first time signing in abroad. Let’s see what I can get.’

“Sign in!”

[Ding! Congratulations, you’ve obtained 10% of Eagle Country Oil Company’s shares.]
